data.body: ARBITER (2026-06-04): APPROVED-TO-START at C1. BINDING CORRECTION: C1 (verify reviewer-hash) NARROWS but does not fully close self-laundering — a sha256 only proves the findings file wasn't tampered, not that a named dso:code-reviewer-* agent wrote it (an agent with the key could write findings:[] + a matching sha + ael_append). So C3 (key boundary) must be an ENFORCED control or an ADR-backed key-INDEPENDENT backstop BEFORE G-A provisions the key — not discipline-only. NITS: (1) C1 commit must state its residual (forged-hash closed; fabricated-findings closed by C3); (2) C2 needs a REAL code change — ael_sha_is_exempt does NOT filter exempt_by today, so add a filter on the decoded e_by field (provenance honors only exempt_by=fp-recovery), not just a doc note; (3) C4 P-AEL-PROVENANCE must be a HARD predicate like P-AEL. C1 reuses record-review.sh:274 (shasum -a 256 over reviewer-findings.json + .sha256 sidecar + 0 critical/important/fragile) — do not reinvent. VERIFIED: .closure-key not provisioned to CI today (units 1-3 coverage consult fail-closed + warn = safe now).
